setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix dashboard && bash scripts/ci-tools.sh dashboard-test && bash scripts/ci-tools.sh lint
checks: npx eslint -c eslint.strict.config.mjs <the .ts and .tsx files you changed>  (the strict rules CI runs on changed files)
npx --yes prettier@3 --check --ignore-unknown <the files you changed>  (the autofix job)
